$comment: The canonical map of what the music UI serves and under which content type. Read by the Node web server (music-dump) and the Rust desktop shell (homelab-music) alike, so neither can drift from the other. Paths are relative to this file's directory and name BUILD OUTPUT in public/ — see vite.config.ts for why the output directory is called public/. Filenames are deliberately unhashed so this manifest stays stable across builds. The document route is listed separately because it answers to two URLs.
